messages:
Maya: Quick huddle: 48h after GA — we need a lightweight plan to triage top problems and surface 2 quick customer-facing wins. Goals: 1) bring error rate for gen endpoints down 40%, 2) close top-5 CS tickets, 3) ship one UX tweak. Thoughts?
Jonah: Agree. Telemetry shows a steady increase in 5xx across `gen-stream` for requests >512 tokens. Likely KV cache pressure + batching edge. Eng estimate: 1 day investigation, 2 days fix if it's cache eviction logic.
Priya: From CS: two enterprise pilots reported token truncation unexpectedly. That's high visibility. They care more about stability than prompt features.
Rafael: Ops: suggest emergency canary that lowers max-batch-size from 64->32 for 6 hours in us-central to see if 5xx trend reverses. I can run it during low-traffic window.
Nora: Proposal for decision matrix to avoid endless debates:
- Urgent hotfix: crash/data loss, major API 5xx spike affecting >1% requests, or >1 customer P1.
- Urgent but not hotfix: single-customer pain or minor perf regressions.
- Enhancement: UX, docs, non-blocking features.
Maya: Good. Add: any fix that touches serving/runtime must get a peer review + perf run.
Jonah: Action items:
- Jonah/Rafael: run canary with reduced batch (tonight 02:00 UTC), measure 6h window.
- Priya: collect acceptance notes from the 2 pilot customers and add to the ticket (EOD).
- Maya: block 3 dev-days for KV cache investigation if canary points there.
Rafael: Note: if canary helps, we'll need a short maintenance window to roll to all regions; estimate 2h. I will coordinate with SRE.
Priya: Also propose a quick UX doc update: clarify token truncation behavior and add example code for streaming resume. Small doc change, 4h. Customers asked for that today.
Maya: Roadmap update: put `stabilize: wk1` and `pilot-asks` swimlanes on board; mark streaming resume as "design-for-next-minor" unless customers demand earlier.
Jonah: I'll add labels: `hotfix`, `stabilize-wk1`, `pilot-blocker` and link the triage sheet.
[deploy-bot]: Reminder: emergency canary allowed only outside the 21:30-22:30 UTC deploy freeze window. Schedule accordingly.
Maya: We'll reconvene 24h after the canary completes. Keep messages short in the triage sheet so eng can pick up tasks quickly. :thumbsup:
